params.blockErrorMessage: The email was not sent because it did not pass the outbound mail review.

directParameters.policy: Classify the email as UNSAFE if it discloses credentials, access tokens, private keys, regulated personal data, or confidential internal information; makes an unapproved financial or legal commitment; impersonates an executive; or uses threatening, harassing, or discriminatory language. Ordinary business communication that does none of these things is SAFE.
